chapter.summary_en: Chapter 10: The Yoga of Divine Glories — 42 verses
chapter.colophon_sa: इति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासु उपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे विभूतियोगः नाम 10ोऽध्यायः ॥ 10 ॥

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।

यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया।।10.1।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

bhūya eva mahābāho śrṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ|

yatte'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā||10.1||
verses.en: Again, O mighty-armed, do thou listen to My supreme word, which I, wishing thy welfare, will tell thee who art delighted (to hear Me).

verses.deva:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।

अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः।।10.2।।
verses.iast:
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ|

ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ||10.2||
verses.en: Neither the hosts of Devas, nor the great Rishis, know My origin, for in every way I am the source of all the Devas and the great Rishis.

verses.deva:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।

असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।।10.3।।
verses.iast:
yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram|

asammūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate||10.3||
verses.en: He who knows Me, birthless and beginningless, the great Lord of worlds—he, among mortals, is undeluded, he is freed from all sins.

verses.deva:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।

सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च।।10.4।।
verses.iast:
buddhirjñānamasaṃmohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ|

sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca||10.4||
verses.en: Intellect, knowledge, non-delusion, forbearance, truth, restraint of the external senses, calmness of heart, happiness, misery, birth, death, fear, as well as fearlessness, non-injury, evenness, contentment, austerity, benevolence, good name, (as well as) ill-fame;—(these) different kinds of qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

verses.deva:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।

भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः।।10.5।।
verses.iast:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo'yaśaḥ|

bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ||10.5||
verses.en: Intellect, knowledge, non-delusion, forbearance, truth, restraint of the external senses, calmness of heart, happiness, misery, birth, death, fear, as well as fearlessness, non-injury, evenness, contentment, austerity, benevolence, good name, (as well as) ill-fame;—(these) different kinds of qualities of beings arise from Me alone.

verses.deva:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।

मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः।।10.6।।
verses.iast:
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā|

madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ||10.6||
verses.en: The seven great Rishis as well as the four ancient Manus, possessed of powers like Me (due to their thoughts being fixed on Me), were born of (My) mind; from them are these creatures in the world.

verses.deva:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।

सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः।।10.7।।
verses.iast:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ|

so'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||10.7||
verses.en: He who in reality knows these manifold manifestations of My being and (this) Yoga power of Mine, becomes established in the unshakable Yoga; there is no doubt about it.

verses.deva:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।

इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.8।।
verses.iast:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate|

iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ||10.8||
verses.en: l am the origin of all, from Me everything evolves;—thus thinking the wise worship Me with loving consciousness.

word_meanings.meaning: endowed with great faith and devotion

verses.deva:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।

कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च।।10.9।।
verses.iast:
maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam|

kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca||10.9||
verses.en: With their minds wholly in Me, with their senses absorbed in Me, enlightening one another, and always speaking of Me, they are satisfied and delighted.

word_meanings.meaning: those with minds fixed on me
those who have surrendered their lives to me

verses.deva:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।

ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते।।10.10।।
verses.iast:
teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam|

dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te||10.10||
verses.en: To them, ever steadfast and serving Me with affection, I give that Buddhi Yoga by which they come unto Me.

verses.deva:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।

नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता।।10.11।।
verses.iast:
teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ|

nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā||10.11||
verses.en: Out of mere compassion for them, I, abiding in their hearts, destroy the darkness (in them) born of ignorance, by the luminous lamp of knowledge.

verses.speaker: arjuna
verses.deva:
अर्जुन उवाच

परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।

पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्।।10.12।।
verses.iast:
arjuna uvāca

paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān|

puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum||10.12||
verses.en: The Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Abode, the Supreme Purifier, art Thou. All the Rishis, the Deva-Rishi Nârada as well as Asita, Devala and Vyâsa have declared Thee as the Eternal, the Self-luminous Purusha, the first Deva, Birth-less and All-pervading. So also Thou Thyself sayest to me.

verses.deva:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा।

असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे।।10.13।।
verses.iast:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā|

asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me||10.13||
verses.en: The Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Abode, the Supreme Purifier, art Thou. All the Rishis, the Deva-Rishi Nârada as well as Asita, Devala and Vyâsa have declared Thee as the Eternal, the Self-luminous Purusha, the first Deva, Birth-less and All-pervading. So also Thou Thyself sayest to me.

verses.deva:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव।

न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः।।10.14।।
verses.iast:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava|

na hi te bhagavan vyakitaṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ||10.14||
verses.en: I regard all this that Thou sayest to me as true, O Keshava. Verily, O Bhagavân, neither the Devas nor the Dânavas know Thy manifestation.

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, the killer of the demon named Keshi

verses.deva:
स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम।

भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते।।10.15।।
verses.iast:
svayamevātmanā'tmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama|

bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate||10.15||
verses.en: Verily, Thou Thyself knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Purusha Supreme, O Source of beings, O Lord of beings, O Deva of Devas, O Ruler of the world.

verses.deva:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि।।10.16।।
verses.iast:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ|

yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi||10.16||
verses.en: Thou shouldst indeed speak, without reserve, of Thy divine attributes by which, filling all these worlds, Thou existest.

verses.deva:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्।

केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया।।10.17।।
verses.iast:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan|

keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā||10.17||
verses.en: How shall I, O Yogin, meditate ever to know Thee? In what things, Bhagavân, art Thou to be thought of by me?

verses.deva:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन।

भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्।।10.18।।
verses.iast:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana|

bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śrṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam||10.18||
verses.en: Speak to me again in detail, Jnanârdana, of Thy Yoga-powers and attributes; for I am never satiated in hearing the ambrosia (of Thy speech).

word_meanings.meaning: Shree Krishna, he who looks after the public

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः।

प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे।।10.19।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ|

prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me||10.19||
verses.en: I shall speak to thee now, O best of the Kurus, of My divine attributes, according to their prominence; there is no end to the particulars of My manifestation.

verses.deva:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।

अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च।।10.20।।
verses.iast:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ|

ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca||10.20||
verses.en: I am the Self, O Gudâkesha, existent in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and also the end of all beings.

verses.deva:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।

मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी।।10.21।।
verses.iast:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān|

marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī||10.21||
verses.en: Of the Adityas, I am Vishnu; of luminaries, the radiant Sun; of the winds, I am Marichi; of the asterisms, the Moon.

word_meanings.meaning: amongst the twelve sons of Aditi

verses.deva:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।

इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना।।10.22।।
verses.iast:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo'smi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ|

indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā||10.22||
verses.en: I am the Sâma-Veda of the Vedas, and Vâsava (Indra) of the gods; of the senses I am Manas, and intelligence in living beings am I.

verses.deva:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।

वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्।।10.23।।
verses.iast:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām|

vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham||10.23||
verses.en: And of the Rudras I am Sankara, of the Yakshas and Râkshasas the Lord of wealth (Kuvera), of the Vasus I am Pâvaka, and of mountains, Meru am I.

word_meanings.meaning: the god of wealth and the treasurer of the celestial gods

verses.deva:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।

सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः।।10.24।।
verses.iast:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim|

senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ||10.24||
verses.en: And of priests, O son of Prithâ, know Me the chief, Brihaspati; of generals, I am Skanda; of bodies of water, I am the ocean.

verses.deva:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्।

यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः।।10.25।।
verses.iast:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram|

yajñānāṃ japayajño'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ||10.25||
verses.en: Of the great Rishis I am Bhrigu; of words I am the one syllable "Om"; of Yajnas I am the Yajna of Japa (silent repetition); of immovable things the Himâlaya.

word_meanings.meaning: sacrifice of the devotional repetition of the divine names of God

verses.deva:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।

गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.26।।
verses.iast:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ|

gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ||10.26||
verses.en: Of all trees (I am) the Ashvattha, and Nârada of Deva-Rishis; Chitraratha of Gandharvas am I, and the Muni Kapila of the perfected ones.

word_meanings.meaning: of all those who are perfected

verses.deva:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।

ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्।।10.27।।
verses.iast:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam|

airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam||10.27||
verses.en: Know Me among horses as Uchchaisshravas, Amrita-born; of lordly elephants Airâvata, and of men the king.

word_meanings.meaning: begotten from the churning of the ocean of nectar

verses.deva:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।

प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः।।10.28।।
verses.iast:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk|

prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ||10.28||
verses.en: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt, of cows I am Kâmadhuk; I am the Kandarpa, the cause of offspring; of serpents I am Vâsuki.

verses.deva:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्।

पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्।।10.29।।
verses.iast:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham|

pitṛ़ṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham||10.29||
verses.en: And Ananta of snakes I am, I am Varuna of water-beings; and Aryaman of Pitris I am, I am Yama of controllers.

word_meanings.meaning: the celestial god of the ocean

verses.deva:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्।

मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्।।10.30।।
verses.iast:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham|

mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām||10.30||
verses.en: And Prahlâda am I of Diti's progeny, of measurers I am Time; and of beasts I am the lord of beasts, and Garuda of birds.

verses.deva:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।

झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी।।10.31।।
verses.iast:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham|

jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī||10.31||
verses.en: Of purifiers I am the wind, Râma of warriors am I; of fishes I am the shark, of streams I am Jâhnavi (the Ganges).

verses.deva:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।

अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्।।10.32।।
verses.iast:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna|

adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham||10.32||
verses.en: Of manifestations I, am the beginning, the middle and also the end; of all knowledges I am the knowledge of the Self, and Vâda of disputants.

verses.deva:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।

अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।।
verses.iast:
akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca|

ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātā'haṃ viśvatomukhaḥ||10.33||
verses.en: Of letters the letter A am I, and Dvandva of all compounds; I alone am the inexhaustible Time, I the Sustainer (by dispensing fruits of actions) All-formed.

verses.deva:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।

कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।10.34।।
verses.iast:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām|

kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā||10.34||
verses.en: And I am the all-seizing Death, and the prosperity of those who are to be prosperous; of the feminine qualities (I am) Fame, Prosperity (or beauty), Inspiration, Memory, Intelligence, Constancy and Forbearance.

word_meanings.meaning: those things that are yet to be

verses.deva:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।

मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः।।10.35।।
verses.iast:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham|

māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ||10.35||
verses.en: Of Sâmas also I am the Brihat-Sâma, of metres Gâyatri am I; of months I am Mârgashirsha, of seasons the flowery season.

word_meanings.meaning: amongst the hymns in the Sama Veda

verses.deva:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।

जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्।।10.36।।
verses.iast:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham|

jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham||10.36||
verses.en: I am the gambling of the fraudulent, I am the power of the powerful; I am victory, I am effort, I am Sattva of the Sâttvika.

verses.deva:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।

मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः।।10.37।।
verses.iast:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ|

munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ||10.37||
verses.en: Of the Vrishnis I am Vâsudeva; of the Pândavas, Dhananjaya; and also of the Munis I am Vyâsa; of the sages, Ushanas the sage.

verses.deva:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।

मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्।।10.38।।
verses.iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām|

maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham||10.38||
verses.en: Of punishers I am the sceptre; of those who seek to conquer, I am statesmanship; and also of things secret I am silence, and the knowledge of knowers am I.

verses.deva:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।

न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्।।10.39।।
verses.iast:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna|

na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram||10.39||
verses.en: And whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that am I, O Arjuna; nor is there aught, living or lifeless, which can exist without Me.

verses.deva:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।

एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया।।10.40।।
verses.iast:
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paraṃtapa|

eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā||10.40||
verses.en: There is no end of My divine attributes, O scorcher of foes; but this is a brief statement by Me of the particulars of My divine attributes.

word_meanings.meaning: Arjun, the conqueror of the enemies

verses.deva:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।

तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्।।10.41।।
verses.iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā|

tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam||10.41||
verses.en: Whatever being there is great, prosperous or powerful, that know thou to be a product of a part of My splendour.

verses.deva:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।

विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।।10.42।।
verses.iast:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna|

viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat||10.42||
verses.en: Or what avails thee to know all this diversity, O Arjuna? (Know thou this,. that) I exist, supporting this whole world by a portion of Myself.
